Laval (Québec)

October 5, 2026

Subject: Change to the annual fee, effective January 1, 2027

Dear client,

The annual policy fee will change from $95.00 CAD to $110.00 CAD on January 1, 2027. The premium itself is unchanged.

This letter is for information only. No action is required and no payment is due now.

The new fee will appear on your January invoice.

Service à la clientèle
